run_pybullet_vr_simulation: run a pybullet simulation that loads a KUKA robot, PR2 gripper, and VR controller plugin
create_pybullet_constraints: create fixed and gear joint constraints between a PR2 gripper and KUKA robot in pybullet
load_urdf_sdf_models: load URDF and SDF robot models like KUKA iiwa, PR2 gripper, and WSG50 gripper into pybullet
control_pybullet_joints: set joint motor control with position control and reset joint states for a pybullet robot
configure_vr_controller_events: configure VR controller event polling and load the vrSyncPlugin for pybullet robot control
